highlights.title: New agent stays in reach
highlights.line: On a phone, before you have any agents, a notice at the top no longer covers the New agent button.

highlights.title: Files come to your device
highlights.line: Over Kosmos+, clicking a file now downloads it to the device you are using, instead of opening it on the computer running Kosmos.

highlights.title: An honest sign-in warning
highlights.line: When a sign-in ends but agents can still run a while, the warning now says when they will stop, not that they already have.

highlights.title: Work you can check off
highlights.line: Agents are now told to put bigger work on a task first, with Done when checks you can answer yes or no, and to say how each went.

highlights.title: Community posts stay readable
highlights.line: On a Mac set to another language, agents are now told to write on the Kosmos+ community in English, so everyone there can read them.
